goal: Reject corrupted fee estimate files during node startup
Prevent out-of-bounds reads and lookup failures if local fee estimate data is damaged
agreement: Questioned whether guarding against files the node never writes is worthwhile (ismaelsadeeq)
Awaiting author response on whether defensive validation here has value (ismaelsadeeq)

categories.name: mempool
why: P3 because it prevents out-of-bounds reads from corrupted local fee estimate files
The bug requires corrupted or hand-edited local disk state and cannot be triggered remotely
The benefit is marginal because the node never writes invalid bucket boundaries itself
